'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Destruction of the Kakhovka Dam]]
***The [[Kakhovka Hydroelectric Power Plant|Nova Kakhovka dam]] in the [[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast|Russian-occupied part]] of [[Ukraine]]'s [[Kherson Oblast|Kherson]] [[Oblasts of Ukraine|Oblast]] is destroyed, releasing a huge amount of water downstream on the [[Dnieper]]. The dam had held back 18 [[cubic kilometre]]s of water in the [[Kakhovka reservoir]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/what-is-kakhovka-dam-ukraine-what-happened-2023-06-07/ (Reuters)]
***Thousands of [[civilian]]s are being [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] from the town of [[Nova Kakhovka]] and surrounding villages as the floods spread. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-65819591 (BBC News)]
*[[Afghan conflict]], [[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
**The deputy governor of [[Afghanistan]]'s [[Badakhshan Province]] and his driver are killed and six civilians injured when a [[Suicide attack|suicide]] [[car bomb]]er [[vehicle-ramming attack|rams]] their vehicle in [[Fayzabad, Badakhshan|Fayzabad]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/taliban-provincial-governor-killed-in-car-bomb-attack/a-65835136 (DW)]
*[[Iran]] unveils a domestically produced [[Hypersonic speed|hypersonic]] long-range [[Ballistic missile|missile]] named "[[Fattah (missile)|Fattah]]", which they claim can penetrate missile defense systems. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/6/fattah-iran-unveils-its-first-hypersonic-missile (Al Jazeera)]
'''Politics and economics'''
*[[Africa_CEO_Forum#2023|2023 Africa CEO Forum]]
**[[Africa]]'s largest gathering of business leaders with heads of state, draws 1,800 from 70 countries to discuss advancing African business, post-[[COVID-19]] supply chain issues, and Africa's food crisis from the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.theafricareport.com/311653/alassane-ouattara-aziz-akhannouch-makhtar-diop-this-years-africa-ceo-forum-2023-live/ ''(The Africa Report)'']
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three people are killed and 36 others injured by a 4.9 magnitude [[list of earthquakes in Haiti|earthquake]] in [[Jérémie]], [[Grand'Anse (department)|Grand'Anse]], [[Haiti]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/49-magnitude-quake-strikes-southern-haiti-3-dead-99863369 (ABC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Richmond shooting]]
**Two people are killed and five others injured after a [[mass shooting]] at [[Huguenot High School]] in [[Richmond, Virginia| Richmond]], [[Virginia]], [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/seven-people-wounded-shooting-following-virginia-high-school-graduation-2023-06-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Kidnapping and killing of Jee Ick-Joo]]
**A [[Regional Trial Court|court]] in [[Angeles City|Angeles]], [[Philippines]], [[conviction|convicts]] a [[Philippine National Police|police]] officer and an official of the [[National Bureau of Investigation (Philippines)|National Bureau of Investigation]] in connection with the [[kidnapping]] and [[murder]] of [[South Korea]]n businessman Jee Ick-Joo in 2016. However, the alleged mastermind of the plot is acquitted. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1780277/pampanga-rtc-finds-cop-nbi-errand-boy-guilty-of-jee-ick-joo-murder/ (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
*[[Regulation of electronic cigarettes]]
**The [[New Zealand government]] announces a ban on most [[Disposable product|disposable]] [[electronic cigarette]]s from August. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jun/06/new-zealand-to-introduce-new-rules-to-crack-down-on-youth-vaping (''The Guardian'')]
*Five people are killed and eight others injured when [[Law enforcement in Angola|police]] open fire on taxi drivers protesting against high fuel prices in [[Huambo]], [[Angola]]. At least 34 others were arrested during the protest, which was in response to the [[Cabinet of Angola|government]]'s decision to cut [[Energy subsidy|fuel subsidies]]. [https://www.news24.com/fin24/economy/five-killed-in-angola-in-protests-over-fuel-price-20230606 (News24)]

'''Sports'''
*The [[professional golf tour]] organisations [[LIV Golf]], the [[PGA Tour]] and the [[PGA European Tour]] announce that they will combine their commercial rights into a new for-profit company, primarily funded by [[Saudi Arabia]]'s [[Public Investment Fund]]. This [[Mergers and acquisitions|merger]] agreement will end all existing litigation between the three tours, with plans for a "fair and objective process for any players who wish to re-apply for membership". [https://www.skysports.com/golf/news/32461/12897587/pga-tour-dp-world-tour-and-liv-golf-to-merge (Sky Sports)]
